svg.title: Documentary authority plate for United States Department of Justice web accessibility guidance
svg.desc: A recreated editorial plate, not a screenshot, identifies the Department of Justice Civil Rights Division guidance titled Guidance on Web Accessibility and the ADA, dated March 18, 2022. It records that labels, clear instructions, error identification, keyboard access, and manual testing are material considerations, while warning that the guidance is informal and not an independent source of binding legal effect.
svg.text: PRIMARY-AUTHORITY DOCUMENTARY PLATE · RECREATED, NOT A SCREENSHOT
U.S. Department of Justice · Civil Rights Division
Evidence: labels · instructions · error recovery · keyboard access · manual testing
Limit: informal guidance; legal application remains matter-specific. Full source linked in the Source Desk.
